title: Run dashboard CI follow-up by default for GitHub Actions projects

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage — SEED-330#make-ci-follow-up-automatic at 5987387021227f7a89b1520917dcd3100564b0aa

Verdict: Confirmed missing test path (bounded to the seven maintained specs examined below).

Promise: Key example 6 / Scope "Projects with a custom CI adapter keep their existing CI reading and get no rerun ... through the existing collection guards this story leaves as they are."

Fault: dashboard/server/ciFollowUpCollection.ts, collectCiFollowUps: deleted the line `if (configuration.adapter !== undefined) return;` (the only change; fixtures and assertions untouched).

Validation of the suggested check (one revision): the suggestion holds, but with a narrower reachable path than "an adapter project lands a qualifying build". By inspection, a project whose history is read through its ciAdapter stores builds that carry adapterAttempt (baseCiAdapterAttempts.ts asAdapterAttempts), and repeatDecisionOf (dashboard/server/ciFollowUpDecision.ts) already returns undefined for any build with adapterAttempt or without runId/runAttempt. So on the pure-adapter path the collection guard is backed by a second guard, and dropping it alone is not observable there (inspection only, not run). The fault becomes observable where an admitted receipt holds a retained GitHub-shaped exact qualifying build while the project's .planning/open-dough.json now names a ciAdapter (for example a project that switches to a custom adapter with GitHub-collected history, or a receipt admitted before that switch). The witness targets that transition.

Scratch witness (independent, scratch-only, deleted with the checkout): dashboard/backend-tests/intent/ic-adapter-witness.spec.ts, two cases built on prepareRepeatScenario (dashboard/tests/support/ciFollowUpScenario.ts). Server 1 (production, no adapter): collectPriors (five 100 s builds), originalJobsAvailable(false), ingest a 105 s Done receipt; poll the Recently done card for "Original exact-attempt jobs are incomplete" (receipt admitted, decision qualifies, no request spent); close. Then, only in the adapter=true case, write .planning/open-dough.json from makeMe.projectCiSettings.with({ ciAdapter: ["node", "provider.mjs"] }) (the deleted case's arrangement from 1e41fcbf5). originalJobsAvailable(true); start server 2; expect.poll(scenario.repeatCalls).toEqual([71]).
- The adapter=false control shows reach: server 2's production pass does send the GitHub Actions rerun POST for run 71 within the 5 s poll (passed in the baseline, the faulted run, and the restored run).
- adapter=true, unfaulted: repeatCalls stays [] (poll fails at line 47 with Received []), in the baseline and restored runs.
- adapter=true, faulted: repeatCalls becomes [71]. The adapter project's retained qualifying landing got a full GitHub Actions rerun: the wrong behavior is observed.
- Caveat: the unfaulted "no rerun" relies on the poll window paired with the control, not on a pass-completion event. A maintained version needs an observable completion signal instead (AGENTS.md: never wait for wall-clock time).

Maintained checks examined (all under dashboard/backend-tests/intent): landed-ci-attempt-start-adapter, landed-ci-proof-adapter-units, landed-ci-scope-adapter-identity, landed-ci-scope-adapter-shared-attempt, landed-ci-scope-proof-adapter-recovery, landed-ci-automatic-repeat, landed-ci-repeat-admission (12 tests). Under the fault every adapter spec passed (both faulted runs), and every follow-up spec either passed or timed out under load on a path with no ciAdapter configured, where the removed line has no effect. None of them hold an admitted follow-up receipt with a retained GitHub-shaped qualifying build while a ciAdapter is configured. The adapter specs collect through the adapter (adapterAttempt builds), and the follow-up specs configure no adapter. The omitted transition: an adapter-configured project with an admitted, retained GitHub-shaped qualifying receipt reaches a production collection pass, which must not POST a rerun. Review was right that the only maintained case reaching adapter behavior (the deleted "development mode and unsupported providers" case in landed-ci-repeat-admission, removed by this story) observed only the retired setting answer, and it never ran collection against an admitted receipt either.

Run observations (command: env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES npx playwright test --config dashboard/playwright.config.ts <specs> --reporter=list; scratch worktree at 598738702, set up with setup-native npm/browser/check, Node 24.21.0):
1. Baseline, 7 maintained specs + witness, workers=2, load 33.2 then 35.8: 13 passed, 1 "failed" (the adapter=true witness asserting the faulted outcome, Received [], the expected correct behavior). Maintained baseline: all 12 passed.
2. Faulted, same command, load 43.9 then 85.2: 8 passed / 6 failed. All 6 failed on load timeouts before the relevant step. All 5 adapter specs passed. Invalid as a fault observation.
3. Faulted, witness only, workers=1, load 54.9 then 59.1: 2 passed. adapter=true observed repeatCalls [71]: wrong behavior.
4. Faulted, 7 maintained specs, workers=2, load 61.8 then 47.3: 11 passed, 1 failed (landed-ci-repeat-admission "original jobs are incomplete": card poll timed out at 5 s with Received undefined). No adapter is configured in that spec, so the fault is inert there: a load timeout, not a catch.
5. Restoration: a trap restored the file after each faulted run; git diff clean, ciFollowUpCollection.ts shasum matched the pre-probe 1103685cc62529885f96204932913296e635d0bd.
6. Restored, same command as baseline, load 41.5 then 45.4: 9 passed, 5 failed, all load timeouts at early polls.
7. Restored, that failed subset, workers=1, load 43.7 then 38.6: all 7 maintained tests passed; witness control passed (rerun [71]); adapter=true showed Received [] (correct behavior).
Cleanup: the scratch worktree was removed; no runner processes remained.

Load note: landed-ci-repeat-admission (Taken case, jobs-incomplete case) and landed-ci-automatic-repeat (exactly-105, refused and uncertain cases) failed on 5 s poll or 30 s test timeouts at loads about 41–85 with workers=2. They passed at load about 33 (workers=2) and about 39–44 (workers=1). These fit the recorded load-timeout pattern and are not fault detections.

Next proof action: add journey proof for the omitted transition. Have a maintained follow-up spec (for example beside landed-ci-repeat-admission) arrange an adapter-configured project holding an admitted, retained GitHub-shaped qualifying receipt. Reuse the deleted case's makeMe.projectCiSettings.with({ ciAdapter }) arrangement and prepareRepeatScenario. Assert that a production collection pass sends no rerun POST. Wait for an observable pass-completion event rather than a poll window. The pure-adapter path (adapterAttempt builds rejected by repeatDecisionOf) is a separate guard. Its proof was not examined here.

Costs: test runtime about 12.9 min across 6 runs (measured); human effort unavailable; agent effort about 35 tool calls (estimated). Invocation-to-report elapsed 1696850 ms (measured).

## Wrap-up disposition

Checked revision: 5987387021227f7a89b1520917dcd3100564b0aa (slice 1; the later
384179b07 changed records only).

Finding: confirmed missing test path for the adapter guard in
`collectCiFollowUps` on the transition where a project gains a custom CI
adapter while an admitted GitHub Actions receipt is retained. Evidence: the
scratch witness above (faulted run 3 observed rerun [71]; maintained adapter
and follow-up specs passed under the fault). The scratch fault is not a
delivered defect; the guard is unchanged by this story.

Decision: reuse matching queued work. The Backlog list story
SEED-330#invoke-custom-ci-rebuilds owns how custom-adapter projects meet the
follow-up collection and will change this guard. Its Scope now states that a
custom provider without a trigger requests no rerun, including for an admitted
GitHub Actions receipt retained from before its adapter was configured, with
maintained proof observing the collection pass end without a rerun request.
No separate correction is queued and its queue position is unchanged.
Canonical follow-up: .planning/seeds/SEED-330-dashboard-ci-follow-up.md#invoke-custom-ci-rebuilds
